claims.content: Customer completes checkout and payment by choosing a checkout option and paying for selected won auction items.

goal.raw_text: Customer completes checkout and payment by choosing a checkout option and paying for selected won auction items.

claims.content: The customer has unpaid auction winnings.
The customer has PayPal or Amazon Payments as their default Method of Payment (MOP).
Payment must be made within seven days (168 hours) of the auction's closing date/time.

The customer clicks the 'Pay Now' link in the 'Congratulations Winner!' notification email, or signs in and sees the 'Winnings Alert', to complete checkout and payment for their unpaid auction winnings.

trigger.raw_text: The customer clicks the 'Pay Now' link in the 'Congratulations Winner!' notification email, or signs in and sees the 'Winnings Alert', to complete checkout and payment for their unpaid auction winnings.

claims.content: The system displays a post-auction checkout page (because the customer has PayPal or Amazon Payments as their default method of payment) with a congratulatory message, a list of the won items, the total amount, and a prompt to complete the transaction(s) by choosing a checkout option.
The customer chooses a checkout option in the Checkout Options section by clicking the PayPal or Amazon Payments logo/radio button.

The system initiates the selected checkout process: if PayPal is selected, the customer is immediately taken to a PayPal-hosted page; if Amazon Payments is selected, the Amazon Payments checkout widget is loaded on the page, the page is grayed out, all other links are disabled, and the rest of the process is per the Amazon integration guidelines documentation.
During the PayPal/Amazon checkout process, the customer is given a shipping option.
The customer completes the transaction(s) through the selected PayPal or Amazon Payments checkout process.
If, in the Checkout Options section, the customer clicks the "Checkout Later" button or radio button, the system immediately grays out the page, disables all links, and a DIV layer appears.
If payment is not received within 168 hours, the item order will be cancelled.
If payment is not completed within 7 days (exactly 168 hours) after winning the auction(s), the payment window expires and any unpaid orders will be cancelled. Exit: the order is cancelled.
The customer has completed their transaction(s) for the won auction items by choosing a checkout option via the selected PayPal or Amazon Payments checkout process.
Payment is received within the 7-day (exactly 168 hours) payment window after winning the auction(s), so the item order is not cancelled.
The user is returned to a Thank You page after completing the Amazon or PayPal checkout process.
Orders won with an alternative payment method (PayPal or Amazon Payments) are no longer in Hold status because payment has been received.
